text: Consolidate SSRF unsafe-address classification onto ONE shared predicate consumed by fetch/url_policy.py (live crawl path, H6/064-F), fetch/http.py, and fetch/sitemap.py (_is_unsafe_address, 065-F). After 064-F(H6) + 065-F land, the CGNAT 100.64.0.0/10 membership check exists as TWO independent copies (url_policy vs sitemap) plus metadata/class flags - divergent reject-lists are a known SSRF drift footgun on a security-critical predicate. Deliberation Option B (deferred). Surface a per-surface coverage matrix and refactor to a single canonical classifier so a future address-class fix cannot be applied to one copy and forgotten in the other. Flagged by PR#166 cycle-16 adversarial review (Security P3 + Architecture P2/borders-P1). Grounded: src/docline/fetch/url_policy.py, fetch/http.py, fetch/sitemap.py:173-189.

SSRF TOCTOU/DNS-rebinding on returned hostname (fetch/sitemap.py validate_sitemap_url): validation classifies resolved IPs then returns the original hostname URL; the HTTP client re-resolves at fetch time, so a TTL-0 attacker can present a public IP at validation and a private/CGNAT IP at fetch, bypassing all address classification. Pre-existing architectural limitation, out of scope for 056-S (width-isolated CGNAT fix). Fix: pin the validated IP into the outbound TCP connection (resolve-once, connect-by-IP + Host header). Flagged by 056-S adversarial review (L2). Source: docs/closure/2026-08-29-056-s-cgnat-ssrf-closure.md. Grounded: src/docline/fetch/sitemap.py validate_sitemap_url.

SSRF hardening: metadata-IP membership check runs pre-parse in fetch/sitemap.py _is_unsafe_address. 'addr in _METADATA_IPS' matches raw strings only, so IPv4-mapped forms (e.g. ::ffff:169.254.169.254) skip the explicit metadata gate. Currently non-exploitable (caught by is_link_local/is_private after normalization) but defeats defense-in-depth intent. Fix: perform metadata-IP membership after parse+normalization against ipaddress objects. Flagged by 056-S adversarial review (L3). Source: docs/closure/2026-08-29-056-s-cgnat-ssrf-closure.md. Grounded: src/docline/fetch/sitemap.py _is_unsafe_address.
